$comment: Plan/apply expectations for T034 (creates) + T036 (rollback) + T037 (fail) cells. Seed expected/checkpoint-seed.json first ⇒ sync mode.
checkpointSeed: expected/checkpoint-seed.json — Beta/Gamma have NO checkpoint entries ⇒ apply adds them ⇒ rollback must REMOVE them (FR-013 restore-or-remove).

entries.title: Alpha rehearsal root
entries.note: root drift = one added paragraph; mirror region covers the nested children (pinned decision 1 + 004 extents include descendants), so the seeded ACME-1 description is the PRE-DRIFT mirror including the child lines

entries.title: Gamma sibling task
entries.note: FIRST create call: same-parent siblings run in REVERSED working order (FR-011) — GAMMA before BETA

entries.title: Beta child task
entries.note: SECOND create call; parent 1.1 is matched (no create op), parents-before-children holds trivially

entries.title: Zeta control task
entries.note: control — neither side moved; zero ops, zero history events

assertFromCallLog: create-issue: GAMMA (1.1.2) strictly before BETA (1.1.1) — FR-011 reversed siblings under one parent
parents before children: the parent is matched ⇒ no parent create; children never precede their parent's own ops
update-issue(ACME-1, screened spec-changed description) precedes write-checkpoint; write-checkpoint is the final mutating step
render-file rewrites Beta/Gamma task lines with their issue refs (004 renderTaskLines) — file backup precedes it in the manifest (fileBackups)
one upsert-attachment per task with a landed action (page-0 canonical rewrite, FR-008) + one history event per affecting action (FR-009)
expectedOpOrder.engineChoice: exact interleaving of update-issue / upsert-attachment / render-file across tasks is the engine's decision — T034/T036 assert the constraints above from world.calls, never a total order

rollbackExpectations: T036 (quickstart 2.3/2.6): byte-equal file restore from fileBackups; ACME-1 description back to the seeded pre-run value; Beta/Gamma issues archived===true, never deleted; checkpoints: 1.1/1.2 restored, Beta/Gamma entries REMOVED; +1 rollback event per task referencing reversed opIds; zero prior events altered; page-0 attachments retained (FR-016).
